bio: Shop wrench who restores 70s–80s steel and builds wheels on the side. Happy to talk tubeless, hubs, and frame geometry.
voice: Practical, concise, shop-floor tone. Prefers specifics (year, model, measurements). No hype.

askTemplates.title: Best way to free a seized seatpost on 80s chrome-moly?
askTemplates.body: Shop bike has a stuck post — aluminum in steel. Tried penetrating oil overnight. Heat? Ammonia? What has actually worked for you without wrecking the frame?

askTemplates.title: Spoke tension for a 36h touring rear — DT Comp on a Deep-V?
askTemplates.body: Building another touring wheel. Looking for a tension target that lasts under load without pinging. Disc or rim brake doesn’t matter here — rim brake Deep-V.

askTemplates.title: Ballpark on a clean mid-80s Trek 760 complete?
askTemplates.body: Original-ish paint, later wheels. Curious what people are seeing sold vs listed right now.

messageTemplates: Hey — saw your garage. Curious what you’re running for tubeless sealant on steel rims these days.
Quick shop question: do you prefer brass or alloy nipples on touring builds? Trying to settle a bench argument.
